validation.invalidFormat: The input format is invalid. Check it and try again.
validation.gatewayDisabled: The console gateway is disabled. Choose another networking method.
validation.peerRequired: Specify at least one peer address, or choose a standalone network.

list.externalTitle: Networks are managed by an external controller
list.externalDetail: This console uses an external authentication service. Configure central networks in that controller.
list.title: Networks
list.description: Organize devices and deploy network configurations.
list.emptyDetail: Create a network, then add registered devices.
list.gatewayUnavailable: Could not load gateway status. You can use specified peers or a standalone network.
list.created: Network created. Add devices to it.

detail.externalTitle: Central networks are managed by an external controller
detail.externalDetail: Manage networks and members in the external controller.
detail.title: Network details
detail.mayBeDeleted: The network may have been deleted.
detail.deploymentHint: After saving, status updates when devices acknowledge the configuration.
detail.membersRefreshFailed: Could not refresh members. Observations may be incomplete.
detail.deleteExplanation: Remove this network’s managed configuration from every member and delete its join credentials. Device records and management access tokens are retained.
detail.deleted: Network deleted. Member configurations are being removed.
detail.deletePrompt_one: Delete {{name}} and its join credentials. {{count}} member will leave this network.
detail.deletePrompt_other: Delete {{name}} and its join credentials. {{count}} members will leave this network.
detail.keepManagement: Device records and management access tokens are retained.

settings.title: Network settings
settings.name: Network name
settings.cidrHint: Leave blank for automatic allocation. If a subnet is set, the network allocates member addresses.
settings.peersHint: One complete address per line, such as tcp://example.com:11010. Saved addresses are sent to all members.
settings.secureHint: Supports device credentials and member access rules. Changing this setting redeploys configurations.
settings.preferIpv6Hint: Sets the network default. Individual members can override it.
settings.identityHint: Leave blank for the server to generate it. If changed, every member must use the new identity.
settings.rotateHint: Rotate the secret and redeploy it to members when saving.
settings.saved: Network settings saved. Deploying them to members.

members.title: Network members
members.emptyDetail: Add registered devices to the network. Online devices receive configurations; offline devices receive them when they reconnect.
members.temporaryExplanation: These peers connect with network credentials and have no console management session.
members.noCandidatesDetail: Issue a management access token on the Devices page and run the registration command first. Devices already in this network are excluded.
members.identityHint: Credential members join for a limited time. Trusted administrator members use the network identity.
members.invalidTtl: Enter a whole number of days between 1 and 365 for the join credential lifetime.
members.removePrompt: Remove {{member}} from {{network}} and remove its managed configuration for this network.
members.keepManagement: The device record and management access token are retained. The console can still manage the device and add it to other networks.
members.removeCredentialWarning: The member’s join credential will also be deleted. Existing connections will lose access to this network.
members.added: Members added. Their configurations will be sent to the devices.
members.removed: Member removed from this network. Its management access token is retained.

member.title: Configure member · {{name}}
member.hostnameHint: Leave blank to use the reported hostname. Manage the console alias on the Devices page.
member.proxyCidrsHint: One complete CIDR per line, such as 192.168.10.0/24. Leave blank to disable subnet forwarding.
member.loadBeforeEdit: Load the advanced configuration before editing to preserve existing parameters.
member.jsonExplanation: Changes are based on the configuration loaded from the server. The central network manages identity, addresses, initial peers, secure mode, and ACL.
member.jsonHint: Only change Core parameters you understand. Omit prefer_ipv6 to inherit the network policy.
member.listenersDefaultHint: Currently using Core default listeners. Enter one complete address per line; clearing the list disables listeners.
member.listenersHint: One complete address per line, such as tcp://0.0.0.0:11010 or udp://[::]:11010. An empty list disables listeners.
member.mtuHint: Leave blank to use the Core default.
member.devNameHint: Leave blank for the device to choose automatically.
member.otherParameters: Other existing parameters are retained. View or edit them under Full configuration.
member.resetExplanation: Clear all advanced overrides, including listeners, subnet forwarding, and the member’s IPv6 policy.
member.saved: Configuration saved. Deployment status updates when the device acknowledges it.
member.resetSaved: Advanced overrides cleared. The device will use the network defaults.

errors.jsonObject: Advanced configuration must be a JSON object.
errors.ipv4Only: Central member subnet forwarding currently supports IPv4 subnets only.
errors.invalidCidr: Invalid subnet: {{value}}. Enter an address and prefix, such as 192.168.10.0/24.
errors.listenerArray: listener_urls must be an array of addresses.
errors.listenerProtocol: This protocol cannot be used for a listener: {{protocol}}

disable_ipv6.label: Disable IPv6
disable_ipv6.hint: IPv6 preference cannot establish IPv6 connections when IPv6 is disabled.

ipv6_public_addr_auto.label: Advertise public IPv6 automatically
ipv6_public_addr_auto.hint: Let the peer choose a reachable public IPv6 address automatically.

no_tun.label: Do not create a virtual interface
no_tun.hint: Run networking and forwarding services only.

multi_thread.label: Run with multiple threads
multi_thread.hint: Handled by the device’s Core runtime.

enable_udp_broadcast_relay.label: Forward UDP broadcasts
enable_udp_broadcast_relay.hint: Allow devices in the network to receive UDP broadcasts.

credentials.title: Network join credentials
credentials.explanation: Credentials let peers join this secure network. Manage device access tokens separately on the Devices page.
credentials.emptyDetail: Generate a credential and provide the join command to a peer.
credentials.boundDeleteTitle: Remove the member to delete its credential
credentials.boundDeleteHint: Remove the corresponding network member before deleting its credential.
credentials.name: Credential name
credentials.nameHint: Optional. Leave blank for the server to generate a unique name.
credentials.resetTtlHint: Leave blank to retain the current expiry time. A new value starts from this save.
credentials.groupsHint: Separate with commas or line breaks. ACL source rules can reference granted groups.
credentials.cidrsHint: Separate with commas or line breaks, such as 192.168.10.0/24. Core validates the allowed scope.
credentials.reusableHint: Credentials bound to a member must retain a single-device identity.
credentials.rotateHint: Previous join commands will stop working. Provide the peer with a new command.
credentials.deletePrompt: Delete {{id}}. Peers using this credential will lose access to the network.
credentials.keepManagement: Device management access tokens are controlled separately.
credentials.secretWarning: This content contains a network credential secret. Only share it with authorized peers.
credentials.invalidTtl: Enter a whole number of days between 1 and 365 for the credential lifetime.
credentials.saved: Network credential saved. Waiting for the peer to acknowledge it.
credentials.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the text manually.

acl.title: Access rules
acl.groupHint: Must be an ACL permission group granted by a network credential.
acl.explanation: Rules match in order. Save the edited list to the network and deploy it to devices.
acl.emptyAllow: Access between members is allowed by default.
acl.emptyDeny: Access between members is denied by default.
acl.portsHint: Separate with commas. Leave blank to match all ports.
acl.discardPrompt: Reloading discards unsaved access rules on this page.
acl.removePrompt: Remove rule {{name}}, then save and deploy the list for the change to take effect on devices.
acl.saved: Access rules saved. Waiting for devices to apply them.

validation.required: Enter the rule name, sources, destinations, and protocols.
validation.port: Invalid port: {{port}}. Enter a port or range between 1 and 65535.
